items.raw_excerpt: Sept 16 : The International Testing Agency (ITA) has completed a 1,000-km test flight in Alaska to examine whether anti-doping blood samples can withstand long journeys without being affected.The trial explored whether drones could offer an additional way of moving samples from testing sites to laboratories,
items.summary_en: The International Testing Agency finished a 1,000-km test flight in Alaska. It wanted to see if anti-doping blood samples can survive long trips by drone. The trial looked at using drones to carry samples from testing sites to laboratories.
items.summary_ko: 국제검사기구가 알래스카에서 1,000km 드론 시험 비행을 마쳤습니다. 드론으로 장거리 운송해도 도핑 혈액 검체가 영향받지 않는지 확인하려는 것이었습니다. 검사 현장에서 실험실까지 드론으로 검체를 옮기는 방안을 살펴보는 시험이었습니다.
items.title_en: Anti-doping agency tests 1,000-km drone flight in Alaska
items.title_ko: 알래스카에서 1,000km 드론 수송 시험 마친 도핑 검사기구
items.title_original: Doping-ITA completes 1,000-km drone test in Alaska

items.raw_excerpt: A woman who borrowed $30,000 to buy a boat to live on in 2024 wasn't expecting it to turn into a $18,000 overdraft and an ongoing battle with her bank.
items.summary_en: A woman borrowed $30,000 in 2024 to buy a boat and live on it. The loan became an $18,000 overdraft and a long fight with her bank. Repayments took up to 99 percent of her income, and her boat dream sank.
items.summary_ko: 한 여성이 2024년 배 한 척을 사서 그 위에서 살기 위해 3만 달러를 빌렸습니다. 그 대출은 1만 8천 달러의 마이너스 통장과 은행과의 오랜 다툼으로 이어졌습니다. 월급의 99퍼센트를 갚는 데 써야 할 만큼 빠듯했고, 결국 배 위에서 살겠다는 꿈은 가라앉았습니다.
items.title_en: Woman's dream of living on a boat ends after loan battle with bank
items.title_ko: 배에서 살겠다던 꿈, 은행과의 싸움 끝에 무너지다
items.title_original: 'Repayments reached 99% of my income': Battling bank over a loan sinks woman's boat dream

items.raw_excerpt: There is a 'limited need' for more housing 'because we're 20 minutes from anything', with existing new houses not selling. But councillors were also told 'every single (Cornish) village in my view for the future is likely to have more housing'.
items.summary_en: Local people in Cornwall said their prayers were answered when a church's unpopular housing plan was rejected. Councillors said there is only a limited need for more housing because the village is 20 minutes from anything. Still, they expect most Cornish villages will grow in the future.
items.summary_ko: 콘월의 한 마을 주민들은 교회가 추진한 인기 없는 주택 건설 계획이 무산되자 기도가 응답받았다고 말했다. 의원들은 마을이 무엇이든 20분 거리에 있어 새 주택 수요가 제한적이라며, 기존에 지어진 신축 주택도 팔리지 않고 있다고 전했다. 그럼에도 미래에는 콘월의 거의 모든 마을에 주택이 더 늘어날 것이라고 전망했다.
items.title_en: Villagers win bid to stop church housing plan
items.title_ko: 콘월 주민, 교회 주택 계획 저지에 환호
items.title_original: Cornwall planning: Residents' prayers are answered over church's unpopular housing bid - Cornwall Live

items.raw_excerpt: About 60 years ago, an oil and gas survey found unusual reefs off the South Australian coastline. Now, a geologist wants to know whether it is evidence of a volcano.
items.summary_en: About 60 years ago, a survey found strange reefs off the South Australian coast. A geologist now wants to find out if these reefs are evidence of an underwater volcano.
items.summary_ko: 약 60년 전, 남호주 앞바다에서 이상한 암초가 발견됐다. 한 지질학자가 이 암초가 해저 화산의 증거인지 알아보려 하고 있다.
items.title_en: Geologist hunts for underwater volcano off South Australia

items.title_original: Geologist hopes to find evidence of underwater volcano

items.raw_excerpt: Quintana Roo this week passed a ban on invasive cosmetic surgery for minors, joining Durango in approving reforms known as “Nicole’s Law.”
items.summary_en: Quintana Roo in Mexico banned invasive cosmetic surgery for minors. The state joins Durango, which passed the same reform known as Nicole's Law. The law aims to protect young people from risky surgery.

items.title_en: Mexican state bans cosmetic surgery for minors
items.title_ko: 멕시코 한 주, 미성년자 성형수술 금지 법안 통과
items.title_original: Quintana Roo passes ‘Nicole’s Law,’ banning cosmetic surgery for minors

items.raw_excerpt: Rajasthan begins nominations for mayor and chairperson elections in 305 urban bodies, with multiple candidates filing for various positions.
items.summary_en: Rajasthan has begun accepting nominations for mayor and chairperson elections in 305 urban local bodies. Several candidates have filed papers for various positions.

items.raw_excerpt: Sept 16 : Red Bull's four-time Formula One champion Max Verstappen took 13 laps and 35 minutes to overtake 100 competitors in a live televised go-karting 'Max vs 100' fun event at Silverstone on Wednesday.Organisers had allowed a maximum 30 laps and 75 minutes for the Dutch driver to work his way through the
items.summary_en: Max Verstappen, a four-time Formula One champion, overtook 100 go-kart drivers in a fun television event at Silverstone. He finished the race in 13 laps and 35 minutes. The organizers allowed up to 30 laps and 75 minutes for him to pass everyone.

items.title_en: Verstappen beats 100 go-kart racers in 35 minutes

items.summary_en: A new charter school has been approved to grow into one of New Zealand's biggest schools. The school will expand to take in many more students. The amount of government funding for the plan is still being discussed.

items.raw_excerpt: Kasimedu fishing harbour struggles with hygiene issues, deterring exporters and impacting fish prices, despite calls for improvement.
items.summary_en: Kasimedu fishing harbour in Chennai has serious hygiene problems. Exporters avoid the harbour because of the dirt and bad smells. This hurts fish prices, and fishermen are asking for better cleaning.

items.raw_excerpt: Feira de arte vai até domingo (20) na Marina da Glória, na capital fluminense. Paralelamente, ocorre a primeira Semana de Arte do Rio, que terá mais de 400 atrações
items.summary_en: The ArtRio art fair runs until Sunday at Marina da Gloria in Rio de Janeiro. It shows new works from 78 galleries. In parallel, the first Rio Art Week takes place with over 400 events.

items.raw_excerpt: Approval for a proposed silver mine in Central NSW was overturned in a legal challenge by a landcare group, but the project is set to be reassessed by the Independent Planning Commission.
items.summary_en: A landcare group won a court case against a big silver mine project in central New South Wales. The approval was overturned. The plan will now be reviewed again by the state planning commission.
items.summary_ko: 중부 뉴사우스웨일스의 천만 달러대 은 광산 계획이 토지보호 단체의 법적 도전으로 승인이 취소됐습니다. 하지만 이 프로젝트는 주 독립계획위원회에서 다시 심사될 예정이라 갈등은 계속됩니다.
items.title_en: Court blocks silver mine approval again

items.raw_excerpt: Older drivers will no longer be required to take a cognitive test in order to keep their driver's licence.
items.summary_en: Older drivers in New Zealand no longer have to pass a thinking test to keep their driver's licence. The change was welcomed by Grey Power, a group that speaks for older people.
items.summary_ko: 이제 뉴질랜드 고령 운전자는 면허를 유지하기 위해 인지능력 검사를 받지 않아도 됩니다. 이 변화는 고령자 단체인 그레이 파워가 환영했습니다.
items.title_en: New Zealand ends forced memory tests for older drivers

items.raw_excerpt: Em Offida, uma pequena localidade italiana na região de Marche, há uma tradição que ainda faz parte do quotidiano das…
items.summary_en: In Offida, a small Italian village in the Marche region, there is a tradition that is still a part of daily life. For more than two hundred years, women have gathered outside their houses to make lace together. They craft the lace by hand on the street, keeping an old craft alive.
items.summary_ko: 마르케 지역의 작은 이탈리아 마을 오피다에는 아직도 일상의 한 부분으로 남아 있는 전통이 있습니다. 200년 넘게 마을 여성들이 집 앞에 모여 함께 레이스를 만들어 왔습니다. 길에서 손으로 레이스를 뜨며 오래된 수공예를 이어 가고 있습니다.
items.title_en: For over 200 years, women in this Italian village have made lace at their front doors
items.title_ko: 200년 넘게 이 작은 이탈리아 마을의 여성들이 집 앞에서 레이스를 만들어 왔습니다
items.title_original: Há mais de 200 anos que as mulheres desta aldeia se juntam à porta de casa para fazer renda - Notícias de Coimbra

items.raw_excerpt: Traffic at the new Gordie Howe International Bridge connecting Windsor, Ont., and Detroit topped 340,000 in its first full month of operation, according to new data.
items.summary_en: Traffic on the new Gordie Howe International Bridge passed 340,000 vehicles in its first full month. The bridge links Windsor, Ontario, and Detroit. The new data shows strong use of the crossing.

items.title_en: New bridge at Windsor-Detroit tops 340,000 vehicles in first full month

items.raw_excerpt: The South Australian Ombudsman has found the Housing Trust failed to ensure a property met "reasonable standards of health and safety" despite multiple reports of black mould from the tenant.
items.summary_en: The South Australian Ombudsman says the Housing Trust failed to keep a home safe and healthy. The tenant had reported black mould many times. The Housing Trust has now apologised to the tenant.

items.title_en: Housing Trust apologises to tenant after delays to remove black mould

items.raw_excerpt: The Bath Street portrait of the musician was painted back in 2018. This week it was tagged “Free Palestine”.
items.summary_en: The Ed Sheeran mural in Dunedin was painted in 2018. This week someone tagged the mural with 'Free Palestine'. The defacing happened amid backlash against Sheeran's tour.

items.raw_excerpt: Coquimbo Unido sigue en caída libre y este miércoles sumó una derrota más a la lista tras caer por 0-1 en su historiado duelo ante Huachipato por la fecha 21 en la Liga de Primera. Sin poder anotar en la reanudación en La Cisterna, el cuadro de Hernán Caputto llegó a tres partidos perdidos consecutivos.
items.summary_en: Coquimbo Unido lost 0-1 to Huachipato in a postponed league game. The team could not score when the match resumed in La Cisterna. It is now their third straight defeat.

items.title_en: Coquimbo loses third game in a row against Huachipato

items.raw_excerpt: Tamika Upton and Romy Teitzel insist an emotive half-time address from coach Scott Prince was the catalyst for the team's return to form.
items.summary_en: The Brisbane Broncos women's rugby team started the season poorly. Coach Scott Prince gave an emotional speech at half-time. Players Tamika Upton and Romy Teitzel say that speech changed the team and helped them win again.

items.summary_en: Chef Paul Ainsworth has taken over the St Enodoc hotel in Rock, Cornwall. The hotel now has a sunny terrace and serves some of the best seafood for miles around. It remains a favourite spot on Cornwall's north coast.
